name: CG · 11 Gemini Image
description: Gateway sub-workflow for Gemini image generation: primary model with retry, fallback model, aspect ratio and size, deadline-aware timeouts, cost tracking. Returns the image as binary; never throws on model failure.

options.timeout: ={{ Math.max(3000, Math.min($("Prepare Image Request").first().json.timeout_ms, $("Prepare Image Request").first().json.deadline_at - $now.toMillis() - 2000)) }}

parameters.content:
## Gemini Image gateway
Every image call goes through here: same retry, fallback, deadline and cost logic as the text gateway.

**Input (1 item):** purpose, models {primary, fallback}, prompt, aspect_ratio (16:9, 1:1, 4:5...), image_size (1K/2K, optional), timeout_ms, deadline_at, pricing, simulate_primary_fail, passthrough.

**Output:** ok, model, mime_type, file_extension, bytes, fallback_used, usage, cost_usd, latency_ms, attempts[], error, passthrough + binary `image` when ok.

Never throws on model failures: the pipeline degrades to an article without an image.

nodeGroups.name: Primary image model
nodeGroups.description: Builds the image request, calls the primary image model (1 retry) and extracts the final image. Anything not OK goes to the fallback.

nodeGroups.name: Fallback image model
nodeGroups.description: Calls the fallback image model with the same request and extracts its image the same way.
